linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Igikoresho cyo Gushiraho
linux_setup_welcome: Gushiraho SP Flash Tool ya Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Gukuramo no kugena moteri yihuta yihuta kugirango ubashe kugarura no kuvugurura umukinnyi wawe bitagoranye.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek kavukire yamashanyarazi hamwe nibisomero rusange byahujwe byateguwe.
linux_card_usb_desc: Tanga desktop uruhushya rwo kuvugana numukinnyi muburyo bwa Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool Sisitemu Kugenzura & Gusuzuma
system_checker_desc: Igenzura ryuzuye ryabashoferi, moderi yintangiriro, uruhushya, namasomero yimikorere kugirango tumenye neza.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Gira mudasobwa yawe yiteguye guhuza umukinyi wawe kugirango agezweho software.
settings_checker_group_advanced: SP Flash Igikoresho cyo Gusuzuma & Ibyuma
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Kugenzura Linux yateye imbere kuri SP Flash Tool, kwinjira kwa USB, uruhushya rukurikirana, hamwe nibice bya sisitemu.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Gira mudasobwa yawe yiteguye guhuza umukinyi wawe no gushiraho software yizewe.
settings_checker_desc: Gira mudasobwa yawe yiteguye guhuza umukinyi wawe no gushiraho software yizewe.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Mudasobwa yawe yiteguye guhuza umukinnyi wawe.
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Urashobora guhuza umukinnyi wawe mugihe ubajijwe.
linux_prep_blocked: Iyi mudasobwa ntishobora gukoresha SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Ijambobanga ryawe rirakenewe rimwe kugirango ushyireho mudasobwa yo kumurika: amategeko ya USB kubikoresho bya MediaTek no kugera ku cyambu.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kugirango ushyireho mudasobwa ya SP Flash Tool, ijambo ryibanga rizakenerwa mu ntambwe ikurikira kugirango ugene amategeko ya USB hanyuma wongere konte yawe mumatsinda asabwa y'abakoresha. Niba wanze, porogaramu izafunga.
linux_prep_fixed: Kwinjira byemewe, SP Flash Tool iriteguye.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Igenamiterere ryuzuye kandi konte yawe yongewe mumatsinda y'abakoresha akenewe kuri SP Flash Tool. Nyamuneka ongera utangire mudasobwa yawe kugirango uruhushya rushya rutangire gukurikizwa, hanyuma wongere ufungure porogaramu. Kanda cheque kugirango ufunge porogaramu nonaha.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Byakozwe, Funga Porogaramu kugirango Utangire Mudasobwa
settings_driver_desc: Mbere yo gukoresha porogaramu kunshuro yambere, ugomba kwinjizamo umushoferi wa MediaTek USB, hanyuma ugasubiramo mudasobwa yawe.
home_desc: Shakisha porogaramu kumurongo cyangwa uhitemo pake yaho, hanyuma uyishyire mubikoresho byawe.
sel_source_desc: Kuramo porogaramu kumurongo, cyangwa winjize pake yaho.
settings_advanced_desc: Erekana uburyo bwo kwishyiriraho, uburyo bwo kwishyiriraho no kurekura muyunguruzi.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Porogaramu igumana nawe binyuze mu kuzimya, guhuza, no kwinjiza.
settings_sp_gui_install: Shyira muri SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Funga Updater hanyuma ifungura SP Flash Tool GUI hamwe na fayili yatoranijwe ikwirakwiza dosiye n'amashusho y'ibice yabanjirijwe.
settings_terminal_desc: Koresha software yawe muri Terminal kugirango ubone amakuru ya tekiniki kumajyambere.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Koresha software yawe muri Command Prompt kugirango ubone amakuru ya tekiniki kumajyambere.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Bihitamo. Intego zimwe za MediaTek zanga gucana kugeza SP Flash Tool ihabwa dosiye yo kwemeza (.auth); ongeraho ibyawe hano niba igikoresho gikeneye kimwe.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Nta dosiye yo gutatanya yabonetse muriyi paki, kuburyo nta tegeko rya konsole ryashoboraga kubakwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Nta SP Flash Tool yubaka cyangwa MTKClient yinjira irahari kubwubu buryo.
terminal_install_failed: Ntushobora gufungura idirishya. Kwinjiza itegeko ryandikiwe {path}.
status_terminal_install: Shyiramo itegeko ryafunguye mu idirishya ryawe ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} will now open running {method}.

• If it isn't already off, power off your {device}.
• If it is connected to USB, disconnect it first.
{hint}
• Connect your device to your computer when the {terminal_name} window has opened.

Click OK to launch and exit Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Impanuro: Niba igikoresho kidahuza mu buryo bwikora, kanda witonze buto yo gusubiramo muri pinhole hamwe na paperclip mugihe uhuza USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Impanuro: Shira igikoresho cyawe muburyo bwo gukuramo porogaramu (biratandukana ukurikije urugero: urugero: kura bateri hanyuma uyigumane hamwe na USB ihuza, cyangwa amashanyarazi hamwe na bateri, cyangwa ufate Volume Down / Up mugihe uhuza USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Shyiramo ukoresheje SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI will now open with your firmware preloaded.

• In SP Flash Tool, select "Download" from the dropdown box.
• Click the "Download" button.
• Make sure your {device} is powered off and disconnected.
{hint}
• Connect the USB cable to your computer after clicking Download.

Click OK to launch SP Flash Tool and exit Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Iyo bishobojwe, insanganyamatsiko ya Rockbox ihita yimurwa kuri Y1 na Y2 nyuma yo kwinjiza neza Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Ntabwo twashoboye gushyira insanganyamatsiko ipaki kumukinyi wawe. Urashobora kongera kugerageza uhereye kuri Igenamiterere.
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Porogaramu yumwimerere isohora imyaka irenga 3.0.7 ntishobora guhuzwa na Y1 yagurishijwe na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Kumurika ibyashaje byubaka kuri ibi bice bizababuza gutangira kugeza verisiyo nshya yongeye gushyirwaho.

Uzi neza ko ushaka kwerekana software yumwimerere isohora kurenza 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Kwerekana byubaka ROM zip ni 240p ihinduka (rom… _240p.zip). 240p yubaka ntishobora guhuzwa na Y1 ibice kuri Innioasis OS iri munsi ya 3.0.7, so Show Old Rockbox Build ishoboye hamwe nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Isohora rya Rockbox-Y1 mbere ya 0.5 ntishobora guhuzwa na Y1 yagurishijwe nyuma ya Werurwe 2026 hamwe na Innioasis OS 3.0.7 yashyizweho mbere.

Kumurika ibyashaje byubaka kuri ibyo bikoresho bizarinda boot.

Uzi neza ko ushaka kwerekana Rockbox yubatswe kera?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Nyamuneka hitamo .zip, .rar archive, cyangwa dosiye ikwirakwiza (* gutatanya * .txt) imbere mububiko bwa software kugirango ushyire software wahisemo kuri {target}.
sel_offline: Urutonde rwa interineti ntiruboneka nonaha. Koresha dosiye yaho, cyangwa urebe isano yawe.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ibikoresho byinshi bya software cyangwa gusasa dosiye wasangaga muri ubu bubiko / ububiko. Nyamuneka hitamo ububiko cyangwa ububiko burimo porogaramu imwe gusa icyarimwe.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Irekurwa ririmo dosiye zirenze imwe, bityo Updater ntishobora kumenya imiterere umukinnyi wawe akeneye. Uwatezimbere {software} yakenera kuvugurura porogaramu zabo kugirango ashyiremo dosiye imwe gusa.
sp_search_restart: Nta gikoresho kiracyariho, kongera gushakisha (gerageza {count}). Komeza umukinnyi amashanyarazi hanyuma uyihuze mugihe ubajije.
sp_auth_missing_file: Idosiye yo kwemeza ntabwo yabonetse ({path}); kumurika nta.
sp_config_missing_platform: Idosiye ikwirakwiza ntabwo itangaza urubuga rwayo, bityo iboneza rya konsole ya dosiye yo kwemeza ntishobora kubakwa; kumurika nta.
sp_config_missing_storage: Idosiye ikwirakwiza ntabwo itangaza ubwoko bwububiko (EMMC / NAND / UFS), bityo iboneza rya konsole ya dosiye yo kwemeza ntishobora kubakwa; kumurika nta.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Nta dosiye yo kwemeza yatanzwe; kumurika nta n'umwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Ntushobora kwandika dosiye iboneza ya konsole; kumurika nta dosiye yemewe.
settings_notifications_desc: Erekana imenyekanisha rya sisitemu kubimenyesha no kuvugurura ubwoko bukurikira. Hanze ibintu byose biri muri porogaramu.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Ubwoko nibisubirwamo byabakinnyi. Abakinnyi b'icyitegererezo kimwe barashobora kubakwa muburyo burenze bumwe - urugero Ubwoko A na Ubwoko B - kandi software ikorerwa imwe murimwe. Reba igikumu inyuma yumukinnyi; niba itavuze ubwoko, siga ihitamo ryambere.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Nta verisiyo iboneka kuriyi software muri kano kanya.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Kumenyesha sisitemu ntibishoboka kuri iyi mudasobwa.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Bika porogaramu muri menu ya menu nyuma yuko idirishya rifunze, uracyabona porogaramu hamwe nabakinnyi bamenyesha ivugurura ryibikoresho. Hanze: gufunga idirishya bireka porogaramu.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Bika porogaramu muri tray ya sisitemu nyuma yuko idirishya rifunze, bityo uracyabona porogaramu yo gukinisha porogaramu. Hanze: gufunga idirishya bireka porogaramu.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Hisha urutonde rwabaturage kumurongo hanyuma ushyire software muri dosiye zaho gusa.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Wamuritse 360p yubaka Rockbox. Urashaka kwinjiza 360p Insanganyamatsiko Pack kuri iki gikoresho ubu?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Huza Umukinnyi muburyo bwa USB Ububiko
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Nyamuneka nyamuneka uhagarike USB, imbaraga kuri hanyuma utangire muri Rockbox inshuro imwe (nuko itangiza imbere yububiko bwa sisitemu ya rockbox), hanyuma wongere uhuze USB hanyuma uhitemo 'USB Storage Mode'.

Mugihe uhujwe, kanda Komeza uhitemo ububiko ubwo aribwo bwose.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Hitamo ububiko ubwo aribwo bubitse bwabakinnyi bawe
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Insanganyamatsiko Pack yinjijwe neza kubikoresho byawe!
sel_only_local: Toranya .zip cyangwa .rar porogaramu yububiko, cyangwa ububiko / gusasa dosiye .txt, kugirango ushyire kumurongo, nta internet ikenewe. Akorana na buri Innioasis na Timmkoo ucuranga amajwi.
sel_only_local_generic: Toranya porogaramu yububiko bwaho (.zip, .rar) cyangwa ububiko burimo dosiye ikwirakwiza kugirango ushyire kumurongo, ikorana nibikoresho rusange bya MediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Shyiramo software ikomoka muri dosiye .zip cyangwa .rar kuri Innioasis cyangwa Timmkoo ucuranga amajwi.
sel_offline_install_generic: Shyiramo software kuva muri .zip / .rar archive cyangwa ububiko bwububiko kubikoresho rusange bya MediaTek.
sel_update_available: Hano hari ibishya kuri {software} biboneka kuri {model} yawe.
conn_offline: Nturi kumurongo. Kwinjiza muri Archive ya Firmware yabaturage ntibishoboka.
conn_archive_unavailable: Cataloge ya software ntishobora kugerwaho byigihe gito. Urashobora kwinjizamo mububiko cyangwa dosiye zaho.
single_instance_body: Indi kopi irakinguye, cyangwa iracyakora inyuma. Kopi ebyiri zahatanira guhuza USB umukinnyi, iyi rero ntabwo izatangira.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi ikora ntabwo yashubije icyifuzo cyo kwerekana idirishya ryayo. Irashobora kuba ihuze cyangwa imanitswe. Imbaraga zo kubireka bizahagarika ikintu cyose irimo gushiraho.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi ikora ntishobora kurangira. Kureka wenyine, hanyuma utangire kuvugurura.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi ikora ni ugushiraho software cyangwa kuvugana numukinnyi, kurangiza rero ubu byahagarika ibyo. Uku gutangiza kuzarangira; koresha idirishya risanzwe cyangwa menu ya bar ya shusho mugihe iyinjizamo rirangiye.
notices_summary_body: Fungura Amatangazo muri porogaramu kugirango uyasome.
toast_battery_charged: Mbere yo gukoresha ibi kumukinyi wawe, shyira bateri byibuze isaha imwe
toast_battery_charged_device: Mbere yo gukoresha ibi kubikoresho byawe, shyira bateri byibuze isaha imwe
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Emera imenyekanisha ryibanze kugirango wakire ivugurura kandi utange integuza nubwo mugihe Updater ifunze kuri menu bar.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Emera imenyekanisha ryibanze kugirango wakire ivugurura kandi utange integuza nubwo mugihe Updater ifunze kuri tray ya sisitemu.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Serivisi zo guhindura kumurongo kuri ubu ntizagerwaho cyangwa kuri cooldown. Inyandiko zo gusohora zumwimerere zizerekanwa aho.
translate_unavailable_hint: Ubuhinduzi ntibushobora kuboneka by'agateganyo. Reba umurongo wa enterineti cyangwa ugerageze nyuma.
sel_notes_hint: Hitamo kurekura kugirango urebe impinduka zayo
flash_wait_desc: Banza uzimye igikoresho. Niba ihujwe ariko itamenyekanye, gerageza insinga ya USB cyangwa icyambu.
dialog_pre_install_header: Nyamuneka reba neza ko {model} yawe yazimye kandi idahujwe na USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Zimya burundu igikoresho cyawe mbere yo gutangira.
• Niba igikoresho cyahagaritswe cyangwa ntigisubize, koresha pin cyangwa paperclip mu mwobo wo gusubiramo kugirango uhindure ingufu muburyo bwo gukuramo.
• Komeza umugozi wa USB uhagarike kurubu.
• Kanda Komeza, hanyuma uhuze igikoresho cyawe ukoresheje USB mugihe ubajijwe.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Kuraho burundu ibikoresho bya MediaTek.
• Komeza umugozi wa USB uhagarike kurubu.
• Ukurikije icyitegererezo, gerageza uhuze cyangwa utinjije bateri (cyangwa ufate Volume Hasi / Hejuru mugihe uhuza).
• Kanda Komeza, hanyuma uhuze umugozi wa USB mugihe ubajije.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Ntidushobora kubika amakuru yawe kuriyi iyinjizamo kubera ko porogaramu yawe ya none idahuye na Gumana Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Hagarika umugozi wa USB hanyuma ukoreshe paperclip cyangwa pin kugirango ukande buto yo gusubiramo, hanyuma ugerageze kongera guhuza.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Birasabwa guhuza umukinnyi na charger yurukuta muminota 30 kugeza kumasaha mbere yo kugerageza guhuza.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Niba uri kuri Windows, menya ko ufite Yashizeho Abashoferi .
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • PC PC ya Windows igomba gutangira nyuma yo gushiraho shoferi mbere yo kuyikoresha bwa mbere.
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Niba utizeye neza, hitamo 'Ibindi' cyangwa software ukeka ko yashizwemo.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kugirango ukomeze niyinjizamo, nyamuneka wemeze niba {model} yawe isanzwe ikora software yibanze ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Turashobora gusa kubika igenamiterere ryawe nibitangazamakuru mugihe umukinyi asanzwe akora iyi software cyangwa verisiyo ihuje.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Turashobora kubika igenamiterere ryawe mugihe umukinyi asanzwe akora iyi software cyangwa verisiyo ihuje.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Turashobora gusa kubika igenamiterere ryawe nibitangazamakuru mugihe umukinyi asanzwe akora iyi software cyangwa verisiyo ihuje.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Emera Komeza Igenamiterere n'Itangazamakuru kuri porogaramu iyo ari yo yose
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Kureka ikibazo cyo guhuza. Gusa koresha ibi mugihe uzi neza ko umukinnyi azakomeza gukorana nigenamiterere ryacyo hamwe nibitangazamakuru.
err_keep_data_failed: Ntushobora kubika igenamiterere ryawe nibitangazamakuru: ububiko bwa software ntabwo bwanditse. Nta kintu na kimwe cyashyizweho.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Komeza igenamiterere ryawe nibitangazamakuru kumukinnyi. Porogaramu isigaye yashyizweho nkuko bisanzwe.
flash_keep_data_warning: Niba ukomeje udafite ibi, igenamiterere ryawe nibitangazamakuru bizasubizwa mububiko bwimbere.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Niba ukomeje udafite ibi, insanganyamatsiko yawe ya Rockbox, imyandikire nigenamiterere bizavaho. Umuziki wawe nibindi bitangazamakuru bizaguma kumukinnyi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Niba ukomeje udafite ibi, insanganyamatsiko yawe ya Rockbox, imyandikire nigenamiterere bizakurwaho, kandi ububiko bwimbere bwabakinnyi buzasubirwamo.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Niba ukomeje udafite ibi, igenamiterere ryawe rizasubirwamo. Umuziki wawe nibindi bitangazamakuru bizaguma kumukinnyi.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Iyi software igomba kuvugurura ububiko bwimbere bwabakinnyi. Igenamiterere ryabitswe rizasibwa; umuziki wawe nibindi bitangazamakuru bizahagarara.
format_all_data_warning_other: Iyi software igomba kuvugurura ububiko bwimbere bwabakinnyi. Igenamiterere ryabitswe hamwe nibitangazamakuru bibitswe mububiko bwubatswe bizasibwa. Itangazamakuru kuri microSD yawe iguma mumwanya.
format_all_confirm_body:
For {software} we need to reformat your {model}'s internal storage before we can proceed. Then another SP Flash Tool attempt will be tried, but in Format All + Download mode via the XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Hagarika USB, hanyuma shyiramo paperclip cyangwa pin muri reset pinhole kuri {model} yawe. Kanda ahakurikira kugirango ugerageze nanone muri Format All + Gukuramo.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yatangaje ko imbonerahamwe yumukino wabakinnyi yahindutse (8502). Iyi software igomba gushyirwaho muburyo bwa Format All + Gukuramo, ivugurura ububiko bwimbere.
install_first_hint: Mbere yo gushiraho {target} kunshuro yambere, {model} yawe igomba kuba ikora {software} - cyangwa {target} ubwayo, niba yamaze gushyirwaho no gukora.
install_first_power_on_fmt: Nyamuneka hagarika USB, imbaraga kuri {model} hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.
install_first_power_on_hint: Reka umukinyi atangire rimwe kuri software yibanze, hanyuma uyizimya kugirango ushyireho ubutaha.
install_first_need_body: {software} ni porogaramu shingiro ya {target}. Bizashyirwa kuri {model} yawe mbere, hanyuma {target} ikurikira byikora.
install_first_when_body: {target} ntigomba gushyirwaho neza hejuru ya {running}: kuri {model} umukinnyi ntabwo azatangira neza nyuma. Kwinjiza {software} ubanza ninzira itekanye, na {target} hanyuma ikurikira byikora.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} ntigomba gushyirwaho neza hejuru ya software isanzwe kuri {model}: umukinnyi ntazatangira neza nyuma. Kwinjiza {software} ubanza ninzira itekanye, na {target} hanyuma ikurikira byikora.
install_first_recommend_body: Your {model} is running {running}. Installing {target} over it may keep {running}'s startup logo and custom device logos. Installing {software} first is the cleanest route: {target} then follows automatically. Yes installs {software} first; No installs {target} now with fresh settings and media.
install_first_starting: Kwinjizamo porogaramu shingiro isabwa {software} mbere ya {target}.
install_first_missing: Iyi porogaramu isaba {software} mbere, ariko kataloge ntishobora kurekurwa {software}.
install_first_version_unavailable: Iyi porogaramu isaba {software} {version}, ariko nta gusohora muri kataloge ihuye nicyo gisabwa.
install_first_needs_answer: Iyi software ikenera igenzura ryibanze, ikenera itumanaho.

keep_data_erase_prompt_y1: Shyiramo kandi uhanagure igenamiterere kuri {model} yawe?
keep_data_erase_prompt_other: Shyiramo kandi uhanagure igenamiterere nibitangazamakuru kububiko bwimbere kuri {model}?
keep_data_erase_explainer_y1: Igenamiterere rizasubirwamo, ariko umuziki na dosiye kurikarita yawe ya microSD bizagumana. Gerageza uko byagenda kose
keep_data_erase_explainer_other: Igenamiterere n'ibitangazamakuru byo kubika imbere bizasubirwamo, ariko itangazamakuru kuri karita yawe ya microSD rizagumana. Gerageza uko byagenda kose

flash_keep_data_unavailable_y1: Iyinjizamo izasubiramo igenamiterere ryawe. Umuziki wawe nibindi bitangazamakuru bizaguma kumukinnyi.

flash_connect_prompt_power: Nyamuneka wemeze neza ko {model} yawe ifite imbaraga kandi idahagaritswe - hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.

support_story_1_lead: Kurinda igikoresho cyawe imitego yibikoresho byicecekeye hamwe nibisubirwamo.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ihora isohora ama firime mashya kubakinnyi nka Y1 (yibanda kubuyobozi bwihishe nka 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) bica bucece ibikoresho bishaje. Ikirushijeho kuba kibi, urubuga rwabo rutanga umuburo wa zeru na zeru kugera kubikorwa byabanjirije gukora kugirango bakire leta yubakishijwe amatafari. Kuvugurura hamwe numushinga Firmware wumushinga utoragura ibice: turabika ububiko bwumurage wose ROM, uhita ugenzura ivugurura ryibikoresho byawe, kandi ugakomeza umukinnyi wawe gukora neza.
support_story_1_item_1: Kurokora Abakinnyi bavunitse: Igenzura ryumutekano ryemeza ko ibishya bishya bitigeze bibumba ibyuma bishaje.
support_story_1_item_2: Ububiko bwububiko bwa ROM: Icyegeranyo cyuzuye cyuruganda rwumwimerere uruganda rwa Innioasis rwasibwe.
support_story_1_item_3: Kavukire-Kavukire: Ibikoresho byuzuye bya macOS, Linux, na Windows kimwe.
support_story_1_item_4: Ibyuma Byubwenge: Automatic board detection kugirango uhore ubona pake iboneye.
support_story_2_headline: Nta bikoresho bya Google byacitse. Nta gukeka-akazi. Gukora software gusa.
support_story_2_lead: Umuvuduko wihuse, ibikorwa remezo byabaturage ushobora gushingira mubyukuri.
support_story_2_body: Gukurikirana porogaramu yemewe ya Innioasis mubisanzwe bisobanura gushakisha amahuriro ya Google Drive yarangiye, imigabane ya Baidu yapfuye, hamwe namadosiye ya zip idafite ibikoresho byaka. Twubatse imiyoboro yizewe, yigenga yo gukuramo hamwe na SHA-256 yagenzuwe neza, kumenyesha amakuru, hamwe nintambwe ku yindi. Intererano zanyu zibika neza ibikururwa hamwe na hosting ituma ibi bishoboka amasaha 24 kumunsi, iminsi 365 kumwaka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct-yihuta CDN: Byihuse, gukuramo byihuse nta mbibi zo gukuramo cyangwa guhuza byapfuye.
support_story_2_item_2: Kuvugurura Amatangazo: Menyeshwa mugihe umuryango mushya urekuye cyangwa ukosore igabanuka.
support_story_2_item_3: Kuyobora Intambwe ku yindi Kwinjiza: Sobanura neza amashusho akugendagenda muri buri kanda.
support_story_2_item_4: Umuryango uvuga indimi nyinshi: Byuzuye mucyongereza, Igishinwa, Ikidage, Icyesipanyoli, Igifaransa & Ikiyapani.
support_story_3_headline: Gufungura ubushobozi bwuzuye bwumukinnyi wawe wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kuzana Rockbox, sisitemu yo gukora yoroheje yoroheje, hamwe nubwisanzure bwamajwi.
support_story_3_body: Porogaramu y'uruganda rwimigabane ishushanya gusa hejuru yibyo ibyuma bya Y1 cyangwa Y2 bishobora gukora. Umuryango wacu wazanye Rockbox, sisitemu yimikorere yoroheje, sisitemu yo gukinisha amajwi, hamwe ninsanganyamatsiko zubuzima. Tugura ibyuma bifatika bitandukana mumufuka kugirango tugerageze, injeniyeri ihindure, kandi tumenye buri kintu cyose. Gushyigikira Updater itera inkunga ibice byikizamini kandi byihutisha iterambere ryibikoresho.
support_story_3_item_1: Kanda imwe-imwe ya Rockbox: Gukina amajwi hamwe ninsanganyamatsiko yihariye yashyizwe mumasegonda.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware yabaturage: Kongera ibikoresho bya bateri, isuku UI, hamwe ninkunga ya codec igezweho.
support_story_3_item_3: Laboratwari ikora yibikoresho: Turagerageza kubikoresho bifatika mbere yo kurekura ibyubaka.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% kubuntu, software-yambere software idafite amatangazo cyangwa gukurikirana.
support_story_4_lead: Kubungabunga ibikoresho bikoreshwa nabaturage birinda ibikoresho byawe imyanda.
support_story_4_body: Iyo isosiyete ikora ibyuma yimukiye mugikoresho gikurikira, moderi zishaje ziratereranwa. Innioasis ntabwo itanga inkunga ya Linux, nta mpinduka zeruye, kandi nta buryo bworoshye bwo gukira mugihe kwishyiriraho byananiranye. Kuvugurura birahari kuko abakoresha ishyaka ntibagomba guta umuziki mwiza cyane. 100% by'imisanzu y'abaturage ijya mu buryo butaziguye kugira ngo iki gikoresho gifungurwe kuri buri wese.
support_story_4_item_1: Inkeragutabara & Unbrick: Byagaragaye ko gukira gutemba nubwo ibikoresho byanze gutangira.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Inkunga Yambere Yambere: Yashyigikiwe byimazeyo MediaTek yaka kuri disiki ya Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Impinduka zisobanutse: Ibisobanuro birambuye byo gusohora kugirango umenye neza impinduka.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% byatewe inkunga nabaturage: Ikawa yose ituma ububiko bwugururwa kandi kubuntu kuri bose.

Kumenya software igikoresho cyawe gifite kwemeza ko kwishyiriraho bikorwa neza kuri software zose ziboneka muri porogaramu.

flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Uburyo bwa macOS bwigana: ikoresha Mac itemba kuriyi mashini, MTKClient niyo yonyine yinyuma kandi macOS yihariye irerekanwa. Kugerageza gusa; porogaramu itangira gusaba.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient ihinduka uburyo bwonyine bwo kwishyiriraho kandi ibisobanuro byihariye bya macOS birerekanwa. MediaTek Installer ikeneye gutangira kugirango ukoreshe ibi.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient ihinduka uburyo bwonyine bwo kwishyiriraho kandi ibisobanuro byihariye bya macOS birerekanwa. Kuvugurura ikeneye gutangira kugirango ukoreshe ibi.
sel_instructions_below: Nyamuneka kurikiza amabwiriza hepfo kugirango ushyire iyi software kuri {lbl}

sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Niba itarazimye, fata {label} yawe.
• Niba ihujwe na USB, banza uhagarike.
• Muri SP Flash Tool, kanda Gukuramo.

Noneho huza USB umugozi kugirango utangire gucana.

Niba uruziga rwawe ruzunguruka nyuma yo kwishyiriraho, shyiramo bumwe muburyo bwa B.

linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Tool yateguwe hamwe na libpng12 ihuza.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Kanda Ongera usuzume cyangwa utangire gushiraho kugirango ukuremo paki.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: MediaTek amategeko akora (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Kwinjira kuri desktop birashoboka.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Tanga uruhushya rimwe kugirango porogaramu ishobore kuvugana nigikoresho cyawe.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Uruhushya rwa USB & udev amategeko yashyizweho neza. Serivisi zashyizweho.
donate_rely_on_you: Mudufashe kumafaranga yo kwiruka, tanga uyumunsi.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Fungura MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: Porogaramu igarure rwose kubisanzwe, gukuramo cache yahanaguwe, kandi kwibutsa bateri byagaruwe.
log_app_reset_defaults: Iboneza rya porogaramu risubire rwose kubisanzwe, gukuramo cache yahanaguwe, kandi kwibutsa bateri byagaruwe (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Komeza ucomeke, Rockbox iratangiye kandi insanganyamatsiko zayo zizongerwaho byikora.
flash_watch_found: Umukinnyi yatahuwe, yongeraho insanganyamatsiko ya Rockbox…
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Reba neza ko yacometse kandi ifunguye. Niba igumye mu mwijima, kanda pin mu mwobo wo gusubiramo hanyuma ufate buto yo hagati (Y1) cyangwa buto ya power (abandi bakinnyi) kugirango utangire. Niba bitazatangira, software ntabwo yafashe, shyiramo indi.
action_flash_complete: Flash yuzuye! Hagarika USB hanyuma usubiremo.
action_recover_powercycle: Imbaraga-cycle umukinnyi (fata imbaraga ~ 10s), hanyuma uhuze - kongera kugerageza ...
action_wait_mtk: Gutegereza igikoresho cya MTK ... Kuraho ibikoresho hanyuma uhuze USB.
action_da_stall: Igikoresho cyahagaritse gusubiza mugihe ugena umukozi wo gukuramo. Kuzimya burundu, guhuza, no kongera kugerageza.
action_detected_brom: Ibikoresho byagaragaye (uburyo bwa BROM) - kugena ibikoresho byo gukuramo ...
action_detected_preloader: Igikoresho cyamenyekanye (uburyo bwa preloader) - kugena umukozi wo gukuramo ...
action_da_wait_back: Umukinnyi yaretse gusubiza mugihe atangiye umukozi wo gukuramo. Gutegereza ko bizagaruka ...
action_device_connected: Igikoresho gihujwe - gutegura amabwiriza yo kwandika ...
log_install_writing: Shyira mubikorwa - kwandika amashusho ya software ...
log_sparse_fmt: Kumenya amashusho ya Android gake kuri {part}, uhindura mubikorwa ...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kugenzura imbonerahamwe y'ibice byananiranye nyuma yo kwandika
err_sp_wrong_model: Wahujije moderi itari yo yumukinnyi. Kanda × buto kugirango uhagarike iyinjizamo, hanyuma uhitemo software kumukinnyi wahujije.
err_sp_timeout: Igikoresho ntabwo cyigeze kibona umukinnyi. Komeza kuyizimya no gucomeka, hanyuma uhuze USB USB mugihe ubisabwe.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Umukinnyi yakoresheje imbaraga hakiri kare. Zimya burundu, hanyuma wongere uyihuze.
err_sp_download_fail: Kwandika byarahagaritswe. Reba umugozi wa USB hamwe nicyambu hamwe na bateri, hanyuma ugerageze.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Umukozi wo gukuramo ntashobora gutangira. Gerageza ubundi buryo bwa flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Umukozi wo gukuramo ntashobora koherezwa kubakinnyi. Zimya umuriro hanyuma wongere uhuze.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Umukinnyi yanze umukozi wo gukuramo (ikosa 6104). Koresha umukozi wo gukuramo uhujwe na SP Flash Tool, hanyuma urebe ko software ikora ihuye nuyu mukinnyi.
err_sp_com_port: Igikoresho ntigishobora gufungura icyambu cyacyo. Funga ibindi bikoresho bimurika hanyuma wongere uhuze.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Icyambu cya USB COM ntigishobora gufungurwa (ikosa 1013). Gutangira mudasobwa yawe bizarekura icyambu gifunze. Nyamuneka ongera utangire mudasobwa yawe hanyuma ugerageze.
err_sp_enable_dram: Igikoresho ntigishobora gutangira kwibuka umukinnyi. Koresha paki yubatswe kuriyi moderi nyayo.
err_sp_storage_read: Igikoresho ntigishobora gusoma ububiko bwabakinnyi. Reba ihuriro; igikoresho gishobora kugira amakosa yibikoresho.
err_attempt_timeout: Igikoresho cyo kumurika cyerekanaga ko nta terambere ryagaragaye mu masegonda {seconds}, bityo kugerageza guhagarara.
err_connection_failed_desc: Ntushobora gushiraho ihuza rihamye numukinnyi. Menya neza ko igikoresho cyakuweho (koresha pin kugirango ukande buto yo gusubiramo niba bikenewe), fungura USB, hanyuma wongere uhuze mugihe ubisabwe.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kumurika byarahagaritswe cyangwa ibikorwa byo kwandika birananirana. Reba neza ko USB yacometse neza kandi bateri ifite umuriro uhagije, hanyuma ugerageze.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Igikoresho kimurika cyerekanye umurongo umwe kumasegonda yanyuma {seconds} kandi ntabwo bigaragara ko ukomeje kwandika software. Flash ishobora kuba yarananiranye. Niba iyi yari iyanyuma yagerageje hamwe na buri buryo kuri sisitemu ishobora gusubira hagati yabo, cyangwa niba MTKClient iboneka kuriyi mashini, ongera utangire mudasobwa hanyuma ugerageze.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Gusa MTKClient irahari kuriyi installation. Flash ishobora kuba yarananiranye. Nyamuneka ongera utangire mudasobwa hanyuma ugerageze.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Iyi mudasobwa irashobora kandi kwinjizamo ukoresheje SP Flash Tool. Niba ubishoboye, hindukira kuri SP Flash Tool hanyuma ugerageze.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash ishobora kuba yarananiranye. Nyamuneka soma ubutumwa hejuru hanyuma utangire mudasobwa mbere yo kugerageza. Niba ukanze OK, porogaramu irareka kugirango ubashe gutangira.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Porogaramu yububiko yabuze dosiye ikwirakwiza cyangwa dosiye zisabwa. Nyamuneka ongera ukuremo paki cyangwa uhitemo dosiye yuzuye ya software.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Idosiye yo kwemeza wahisemo irabuze, irimo ubusa cyangwa ntishobora kwandikwa. Hitamo dosiye yemewe, cyangwa uyisibe muri Igenamiterere, hanyuma wongere wongere.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Igikoresho kimurika cyangwa sisitemu ya sisitemu isabwa ntishobora gutangizwa. Nyamuneka reba uruhushya rwa sisitemu, gushiraho umushoferi, cyangwa kongera kugarura porogaramu.
err_driver_missing_desc: Iri kosa rishobora kubaho mugihe umushoferi wa MediaTek USB adashizweho. Kanda Gukuramo Abashoferi kugirango ushyire MediaTek USB umushoferi, ongera utangire mudasobwa yawe, hanyuma ugerageze.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Idosiye yububiko bwa cashe yabuze. Hitamo Hitamo Software kugirango wongere wubake dosiye yakuweho cyangwa ukuremo ububiko bwa software. Iki nikibazo cya dosiye yibanze, ntabwo ari ikibazo cya USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Garuka Kuri Hitamo Software kugirango wongere wubake cyangwa ukuremo porogaramu yububiko.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Hitamo porogaramu irekura kugirango wongere ukuremo.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Ikosa ritunguranye ryabaye mugihe cyo kwishyiriraho ({detail}). Zimya umukinnyi rwose, ongera uhuze iyo ubisabwe, hanyuma ugerageze.
flash_method_confirm: Shyiramo uburyo bwahinduwe kuri {method}. Emeza umukinnyi udacomeka kandi afite amashanyarazi, hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.
flash_failover_note: {method} ntabwo yabonye kwishyiriraho. Nyuma yuko umukinyi afite amashanyarazi kandi adacomeka, {other} azakoreshwa aho.
themepack_card_desc: Harimo insanganyamatsiko nziza zabaturage, ibisubizo bihanitse cyane, hamwe nimyandikire yakozwe cyane cyane kuri 360p yerekanwe.
themepack_step1_title: Intambwe ya 1: Ihuze muburyo bwo kubika USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Hindura umukinnyi wawe ufashe buto ya Power.
2. Iyo Rockbox itangiye, shyira USB USB muri mudasobwa yawe.
3. Niba ubajijwe kuri ecran yabakinnyi, wemeze uburyo bwo kubika USB kugirango igikoresho kigaragare nka disiki.
themepack_step2_title: Intambwe ya 2: Hitamo Ububiko ubwo aribwo bwose
themepack_step2_desc: Kuberako sisitemu y'imikorere (nka macOS) ihisha dotfile (nka .rockbox) muburyo budasanzwe, urashobora guhitamo ububiko ubwo aribwo bwose cyangwa umuzi wa drive kumukinnyi wawe. Tuzahita tubona cyangwa dukore ububiko bwa .rockbox kubwawe.
themepack_complete: Ipaki yinsanganyamatsiko yashizwemo neza! Urashobora noneho guhagarika neza umukinnyi wawe hanyuma ugahitamo insanganyamatsiko muri Rockbox (Igenamiterere> Igenamiterere ry'insanganyamatsiko).
themepack_err_not_found: Ntushobora kumenya cyangwa gutangiza ububiko bwa .rockbox kuri disiki yatoranijwe. Nyamuneka wemeze ko wahisemo ububiko kumukinnyi wawe.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Intambwe ya 1: Ongera utangire umukinnyi hanyuma wongere uhuze
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Hagarika umugozi wa USB.
2. Subiza umukinnyi inyuma hanyuma ureke itangire muri Rockbox.
3. Rockbox imaze gukora, ongera uhuze USB, hanyuma ukande Komeza.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Intambwe ya 2: Ushakisha umukinnyi hejuru ya ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Porogaramu ireba ihuza rya ADB (kugeza amasegonda 30). Niba igikoresho kibonetse, insanganyamatsiko zirimurwa hanyuma umukinnyi asubiramo mu buryo bwikora. Bitabaye ibyo, jya imbere kuri USB Ububiko.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Nta gikoresho cya ADB cyagaragaye mu masegonda 30; gukomeza hamwe na USB Ububiko.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Nta binini ya ADB iboneka kuri porogaramu; gukomeza hamwe na USB Ububiko.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Gusunika insanganyamatsiko nimyandikire hejuru ya ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Kwimura ADB byarananiranye; kugwa kuri USB Ububiko
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Gushoboza USB Ububiko bwa USB kumukinyi kugirango bigaragare nka disiki.
2. Tora ububiko ubwo aribwo bwose kumukinyi uri hepfo (.rockbox, Umuziki, Insanganyamatsiko, cyangwa umuzi wa drive, ububiko bwihishe .ububiko bwa rockbox buri mu buryo bwikora).
3. Porogaramu ihuza insanganyamatsiko hamwe nimyandikire ya 360p, ikandika dosiye imwe.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Urashobora noneho guhagarika neza umukinnyi hanyuma ugahitamo insanganyamatsiko muri Rockbox (Igenamiterere> Igenamiterere ry'insanganyamatsiko).
rockbox_cleanup_step: Kuraho igenamiterere rya kera rya Rockbox ...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Porogaramu yawe nshya yarashizweho, ariko ububiko bwa kera .rockbox ntibushobora kuvaho. Siba ububiko bwa .rockbox kumukinnyi ukoresheje intoki niba ushaka intangiriro isukuye.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Abakinnyi barenze umwe bahujwe. Hagarika abandi hanyuma usige imwe yashizwemo.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Umukinnyi yamenyekanye. Gushyira insanganyamatsiko zabaturage & Imyandikire ...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Fata buto yo hagati kugirango ubone imbaraga kuri Y1 yawe, ongera uhuze USB, hanyuma uhitemo USB Ububiko.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Fata buto ya power kugirango ubone imbaraga kumukinyi wawe, ongera uhuze USB, hanyuma uhitemo USB Ububiko.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Nyamuneka uhagarike imbaraga kuri {model}, hanyuma ukande ahakurikira
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Hagarika USB, fata {button} kugirango ubone imbaraga kuri {model}, hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Ongeraho umugozi wa USB kuri {model}, hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Nyamuneka hitamo umukinnyi ubwayo cyangwa ububiko bwa .rockbox
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Nuwuhe mukinnyi ushyiraho insanganyamatsiko ya Rockbox?
rockbox_select_software_hint: Hitamo umukinnyi wawe na software hejuru, cyangwa uyihuze hejuru ya USB kugirango ubimenye mu buryo bwikora.
completion_installed_get_themes_non_dona: Twashizeho {software} kuri {model} yawe. Urashobora {get_themes} ukanze buto ya {palette}.
completion_installed_guide_and_themes_no: Twashizeho {software} kuri {model} yawe. Kanda {globe} kugirango urebe ubuyobozi, cyangwa {get_themes} ukanze buto ya {palette}.
completion_installed_get_themes_donation: Urashobora {get_themes} kuri {model} yawe ukoresheje buto ya Get Insanganyamatsiko hepfo.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_non_: Twashizeho {software} kuri {model} yawe, ariko insanganyamatsiko ntishobora kwimurwa mu buryo bwikora. Urashobora {get_themes} ukanze buto ya {palette}.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_dona: Insanganyamatsiko ntishobora kwimurwa mu buryo bwikora. Urashobora {get_themes} intoki ukoresheje buto hepfo.
completion_240p_manual_heading: {software} kuri {model} ishyigikira insanganyamatsiko ya iPod ya 240p
completion_240p_manual_body: Ntugomba gukenera insanganyamatsiko ya 360p - kanda {get_themes} kugirango urebe insanganyamatsiko 240p.
settings_get_240p_themes_link: Kubona 240p Y1 / Y2 / iPod Ingingo Zisanzwe
rockbox_reconnect_after_disconnect: USB ihuza yabuze. Ongera utangire {model} hanyuma wongere uhuze USB kugirango ukomeze.
rockbox_paperclip_restart_tip: Impanuro: Koresha paperclip muri reset pinhole kugirango uzimye vuba hanyuma utangire {model}.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb_storage: Nyamuneka uhuze {model} yawe na USB uburyo bwo kohereza
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Nyamuneka ushoboze uburyo bwo kubika USB kubikoresho byawe hanyuma ukande ahakurikira
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Nyamuneka ushoboze uburyo bwo kubika USB kuri {model}, hanyuma uhitemo disiki igaragara
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Nyamuneka hitamo umukinnyi ubwayo cyangwa bumwe mububiko kuriyo
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Hagarika USB n'imbaraga kuri Y1 yawe, hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Hagarika USB n'imbaraga kuri {model}, hanyuma ukande ahakurikira.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Hitamo 'USB Ububiko Mode' kumukinyi wawe.
2. Kanda 'Gushakisha Ububiko ...' kugirango uhitemo umukinnyi wawe hanyuma ushyire insanganyamatsiko.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Iyi Rockbox yubaka ikoresha insanganyamatsiko 240 × 320, zidahujwe. Shaka insanganyamatsiko kubuntu kubakinnyi bawe kurubuga rwibanze rwa Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Niba {model} yawe idatangiye, hagarika USB, komeza buto ya power ya 10s kugirango usubiremo, hanyuma imbaraga kuri. Cyangwa kugarura software yumwimerere.
err_storage_full_desc: Mudasobwa yawe yabuze umwanya wo kubika. Nyamuneka reba umwanya wa disiki kuri disiki yawe hanyuma ugerageze.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Verisiyo ishaje ya Updater iracyari kuri mudasobwa kandi ifata umwanya wa disiki. Kurandura birekura uwo mwanya.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Kuraho porogaramu ishaje ya Innioasis hamwe nububiko bwububiko
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Komeza ibikoresho bya platform ya Android (ADB / Fastboot)
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Niba udakoresha ADB cyangwa Fastboot hanze ya Updater, reba kugirango ukuremo kandi usubize ububiko bwinyongera.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Byasukuye neza kwishyiriraho umurage no kugarura umwanya wa disiki.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Verisiyo ishaje ya Updater iracyari kuri iyi mudasobwa. Kuramo, birekura umwanya wa disiki.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Ibi bikuraho burundu porogaramu ishaje, gukuramo software, hamwe na dosiye zisigaye.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Kuraho ibikoresho bya platform ya Android (ADB / Fastboot) nayo? Hitamo Gumana niba ukoresha ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Hishura dosiye yinjira muri Finder / Explorer
settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Inkunga ya Windows ntabwo igeragezwa. Kuri mudasobwa zigendanwa za Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig irashobora gukoreshwa hamwe na Driver Signature Enforcement yamugaye kugirango ushyire WinUSB cyangwa libusb kubikoresho bya MT6227 Preloader muri Manager wa Device. Reba umuyobozi wa ARM64 uyobora intambwe.
